sources.summary: Andrea Trimarchi and Simone Farresin of design studio Formafantasma have been named the first-ever lead research and development fellows of ecology for London's Serpentine Galleries. Beginning this summer, the duo will evaluate the sustainability credentials of the Serpentine Galleries' day-to-day activities and help to shape its long-term environmental strategy.
